facts.included_package: Frame, fork, seatpost, separate or integrated cockpit, seat cover, headset, thru-axles and seat clamp; choose exact cockpit/finish options.
facts.intended_category: Manufacturer identifies this exact 2023 model as cyclocross, with 42C maximum; kept as a research candidate pending category support.
